authorizationDeviceCode.description: Private runtime-only device code, combined with an initiating-key signature in the JSON body. Never place in chat, logs, or URLs.

session.name: prosit_session
session.description: Management session issued by login. Agent credentials cannot perform management actions.

deviceToken.description: Device-specific opaque API credential; read/publish scopes are bound to its signed certificate. Provisional tokens only poll their pairing.

retry_after_seconds.description: For rate_limited responses, seconds until the blocking window expires; matches Retry-After.

rate_limit_scope.description: For rate_limited responses, the limiter category only; never an account ID, IP, or credential.

passphrase_kdf.description: Present only for passphrase-based vault-key wrapping. prf_salt is then the 32-byte PBKDF2 salt. Omitting this field retains v0.3.0 PRF wrapping.
